text.p: Cophil Exploration Corp said on Monday that its board had approved a plan to invest in a savings bank and a petrochemical company.

The company told the Philippine Stock Exchange in a statement that it plans to invest 65 million pesos for a 51 percent equity in Express Savings Bank, and another 55 million pesos to put up four branches in 1997.
The board also agreed to invest 220 million for a 6.29 percent stake in Petrochemicals Corp of Asia Pacific.
The company said it was considering a joint venture project with unidentified Japanese groups to develop a 360-million-peso, 200-hectare industrial estate in Cavite, south of Manila.
The board also allocated 150 million pesos for its oil exploration activities over three years.
Cophil recently changed its primary purpose to become a holding company from being an oil exploration company.
